name: WondLa
description: Forced to flee her underground sanctuary for Earth’s surface, Eva discovers a world unlike anything she expected. As she journeys across perilous terrain and unknown civilizations, Eva searches to answer the ultimate question: Is she the last human?

videos.title: Chapter 1: Doors
videos.overview: An intruder attacks Sanctuary 573, forcing Eva above ground. Alone, she relies on her survival skills and a cryptic note labeled "WondLa."

videos.title: Chapter 2: Lifeforms
videos.overview: Eva discovers she’s on a planet called Orbona, where she meets a telepathic water bear named Otto and a surly alien named Rovender.

videos.title: Chapter 3: Bargain
videos.overview: Determined to find other humans, Eva enlists Rovender's help—but getting her first real lead comes at a high price.

videos.title: Chapter 4: Ghosts
videos.overview: Eva visits a sage and learns a grim fact about humans. Undeterred, she doubles down on her quest as Besteel the bounty hunter closes in.

videos.title: Chapter 5: Captive
videos.overview: Despite Muthr's protests, Eva follows through on a daring plan and forms a friendship with an unlikely ally.

videos.title: Chapter 6: Bridge
videos.overview: With a possible human civilization finally in sight, Eva and her friends face their most dangerous mission yet.

videos.title: Chapter 7: Ruins
videos.overview: Eva learns the truth about humankind as Besteel tracks her down for a cataclysmic face-off.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Eva arrives at the hidden city of New Attica, where she learns humans believe the worst about Orbona.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Eva chases a mysterious figure deep into New Attica, leading to the discovery of a group of outsiders.

videos.title: Discovery
videos.overview: Desperate to locate her friends, Eva is horrified to find them in the clutches of a sinister threat.

videos.title: Lesson
videos.overview: After a narrow escape, Eva, Eight, and Hailey trek the perilous wastelands to bring an injured Rovender home.

videos.title: Truth
videos.overview: The Caeruleans refuse to let a dying Rovender back into their community. To save him, Eva seeks a mystical creature to restore his honor.

videos.title: Connection
videos.overview: During a Caerulean celebration, Eva connects with a powerful entity. Cadmus and his warbots bear down on Faunas.

videos.title: Heart
videos.overview: Eva risks her life to protect the Heart of the Forest.

videos.title: Rise
videos.overview: After being left for dead, Eight braves the Orbona desert to expose Cadmus' lies—and stage a revolt.

videos.title: Return
videos.overview: Eva wakes to a decimated Orbona and meets with Arius, the sage. Armed with a prophecy, Eva and Rovender head to Solas with a new goal.

videos.title: Mission
videos.overview: Loroc seizes power and declares war on the humans, prompting Eva to join forces with Queen Ojo—and an ally with an eerily familiar face.

videos.title: Monsters
videos.overview: Eva reunites with Eight at last, only to learn that Eight is leading the human assault on Orbona. Torn and confused, Eva must choose a side.

videos.title: Lost
videos.overview: Amid the fog of war, Eva and the team search for the Heart of the Forest in a crumbling New Attica.

videos.title: WondLa
videos.overview: With the fate of the planet at stake, Eva fights to deliver the Heart into the thermal vent.
